name: Cactus
hook: Soft, mushy base? Your cactus is being overwatered.

steps.title: Your sunniest window
steps.tip: A south or west window with several hours of direct sun, all year. Under grow lights, run them 14–16 h.

steps.title: Soak, then let it dry
steps.tip: In spring and summer water only once the soil is completely dry; in winter, just enough to stop shrivelling.

steps.title: Gritty, fast-draining mix
steps.tip: Cactus compost, or half potting soil and half coarse sand or grit, in a pot with drainage holes.

steps.title: A cool winter rest
steps.tip: Grow it at 18–29°C, then give it a cool 7–13°C winter rest away from radiators to set flowers.

steps.title: Feed sparingly
steps.tip: A low-nitrogen cactus feed at most monthly in the growing season, and none at all in winter.

steps.title: Repot with care
steps.tip: In spring, move up one pot size only. Wrap it in newspaper to handle, and wait a few days to water.

outro: Lots of sun, little water, a cool winter: then come the flowers.
